items.html: Also know that each of these Elokim Mochin expands into many aspects and combinations, for Elokim combines into one hundred and twenty combinations, as mentioned in the Book of Creation (Sefer Yetzirah). For a word of five letters builds one hundred and twenty houses. And see the discourse on the twenty-four thousand students of Rabbi Akiva, for there this is explained at length. And behold, all this is in the Mochin of nursing.
